Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant-I position at CSIR NEERI is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Assistant-I post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Assistant-I position, candidates must have completed SSC/10th standard along with an ITI qualification from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant-I post is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant-I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant-I position at CSIR NEERI through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant-I post will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Project Assistant-I position is a contractual job. The appointment will be on a contractual basis for a specific period as per the project requirements.
